name: Tim Sheehy
summary:
Timothy Patrick Sheehy ( SHEE-hee; born November 18, 1985) is an American politician and businessman serving since 2025 as the junior United States senator from Montana. A member of the Republican Party, he is the youngest Republican U.S. senator and the second-youngest U.S. senator, after Jon Ossoff.
In 2014, Sheehy founded Bridger Aerospace, an aerial firefighting and wildfire management company.
